skills.name: pptx
skills.purpose: Anthropic's reference PowerPoint skill: create decks from scratch with PptxGenJS, edit existing decks and templates through OOXML, read and extract slide text with markitdown, and handle layouts, speaker notes, comments and thumbnail renders for visual QA.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers whenever a .pptx/.potx file is involved or a PowerPoint deck is requested. Bundled in claude.ai and Claude Code document skills; needs Python (python-pptx, markitdown), Node (pptxgenjs) and LibreOffice (soffice) for rendering checks.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic; skills.sh ~231k installs (claudemarketplaces ~204k); in ComposioHQ, travisvn and brycewang/many-ppt-skills lists. Also ranked in docs_office.
skills.notes: LINK-ONLY: source-available/proprietary license, do not redistribute. Open alternatives below (ppt-master, PptxGenJS/MiniMax pptx-generator in docs_office).

skills.name: ppt-master
skills.purpose: Routed workflow that turns documents, notes or briefs into natively editable PPTX: strategist/executor roles, design spec and spec lock, reusable Brand/Style/Layout workspaces, filling native templates, rebuilding page visuals, beautifying finished decks, and narrated or self-running video output.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on create/redesign/template/fill/enhance a PPT or deck, or 'ppt-master'. Clone the repo or install the skill folder; needs Python 3 with its requirements. AI images are optional and use your own provider key (OpenAI-compatible, MiniMax, etc.).
skills.evidence: 57.5k stars since Dec 2025; skills.sh ~16.9k installs and on the skills.sh hot list (Oct 2026); listed in cosen1024/awesome-presentation-skills and brycewang/many-ppt-skills (19 mentions). Also ranked in docs_office.
skills.notes: Heavy (13k files incl. icon libraries). SPONSORS.md carries affiliate links to third-party API relays (packyapi, apikey.fan, runapi, apimart) and the image docs show an optional relay base URL: nothing is sent there by default, but only configure official provider endpoints. 'Telemetry' in its docs is local token-usage logging, not network telemetry.

skills.name: slideshow
skills.purpose: Authors an interactive HyperFrames deck: discrete slides with fragment reveals, branching and hotspot navigation, built-in presenter mode with speaker notes in a JSON island, per-slide snapshots, and conversion of an existing web page into a deck.
skills.how_to_use: Install from heygen-com/hyperframes (plugin or `npx skills add`); routes via /hyperframes and needs Node plus the `hyperframes` CLI (`hyperframes present <dir>` to run the deck). Confirms with the user before authoring; do not `render` a deck to MP4 (unsupported, truncates).
skills.evidence: Official HeyGen; skills.sh ~269k installs and #84 on skills.sh trending (~3k installs in the current window); claudemarketplaces ~143k installs; repo created Mar 2026 and now 56k stars.
skills.notes: Depends on the HyperFrames core skills and CLI. Linear MP4 export of a deck is not supported yet (the ai-video craft covers video).

skills.name: slidev
skills.purpose: Official Slidev skill for Markdown + Vue developer decks: layouts, code highlighting and magic-move, animations and clicks, LaTeX/Mermaid/PlantUML, presenter notes and recording, and export to PDF, PPTX, PNG or a hosted SPA.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on technical talks, code walkthroughs, teaching or developer decks. Needs Node/pnpm (`pnpm create slidev`, `slidev export` uses Playwright).
skills.evidence: Official Slidev repo (48.9k stars); skills.sh ~12.1k installs plus ~14.1k for the antfu/skills copy; in brycewang/many-ppt-skills. Also ranked in docs_office.

skills.name: scientific-slides
skills.purpose: Builds research talks (conference, seminar, thesis defense) in PowerPoint or LaTeX Beamer: talk-length and slide-count planning, slide structure templates, design rules for figures and data, timing guidance, and render-based visual validation.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on research/conference/defense slides. Python 3.12+ with python-pptx, PyMuPDF, Pillow; Beamer needs TeX Live; PPTX generation uses Node + PptxGenJS; LibreOffice for review renders. AI slide images are optional and need OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
skills.evidence: K-Dense scientific-agent-skills (47.5k stars); skills.sh ~1.9k installs; also shipped on aitmpl (davila7/claude-code-templates, ~1.3k installs).
skills.notes: Optional image generation calls openrouter.ai (an aggregator, same treatment as image_creation's OpenRouter skills); the slide-building path works without it.

skills.name: pitch-deck
skills.purpose: Populates investment-banking pitch deck templates from Excel/CSV source data: maps content to slide layouts, applies formatting standards for text, tables and charts, verifies financial calculations (CAGR, consensus), and revalidates edited slides.
skills.how_to_use: Use when the user supplies a PowerPoint template and source data to fill (not for decks from scratch). Install the investment-banking plugin from anthropics/financial-services; works in the PowerPoint add-in or headless via python-pptx. Siblings: deck-refresh (roll numbers forward across a deck), ib-check-deck (number/terminology QA), ppt-template-creator (turn a .pptx template into a reusable skill).
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic (financial-services plugins, 38.6k stars); skills.sh ~2.3k installs (+~1.1k under the older financial-services-plugins name); deck-refresh ~1.6k, ib-check-deck ~1.6k, ppt-template-creator ~2.1k installs.
skills.notes: Banking pitchbook flavour; for startup/investor story use presentation-creator (rank 19). deck-refresh (plugins/vertical-plugins/financial-analysis/skills/deck-refresh) is the best general tool for quarterly/internal review decks.

skills.name: gws-slides
skills.purpose: Google Slides through the official Google Workspace CLI: create presentations, read slide content, and apply batchUpdate requests (add slides, shapes, text, images, replace text).
skills.how_to_use: Requires the `gws` binary and OAuth login; load gws-shared for auth rules. Pair with recipe-create-presentation (create a deck and share it) from the same repo.
skills.evidence: Official Google Workspace org (31.2k stars); skills.sh ~40.1k installs, recipe-create-presentation ~31.3k. Also ranked in docs_office.
skills.notes: API reference style; design and story guidance must come from other skills.

skills.name: frontend-slides
skills.purpose: Creates zero-dependency, animation-rich single-file HTML decks on a fixed 1920x1080 stage, or converts PPTX to web; helps non-designers pick an aesthetic by generating visual style previews, with a library of distinctive templates and anti-'AI slop' design rules.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on building a presentation, converting PPT/PPTX to web, or slides for a talk/pitch. No build step; optional Playwright for PDF export and optional Vercel deploy.
skills.evidence: 30.1k stars; skills.sh ~1k direct installs plus ~9.4k for the copies shipped in affaan-m/ECC (272k stars); in VoltAgent, travisvn, cosen1024 and brycewang lists (35 mentions). Also ranked in docs_office.
skills.notes: SKILL.md at repo root. HTML output, not native PPTX.

skills.name: guizang-ppt-skill
skills.purpose: Single-file horizontal-swipe web decks in two systems (magazine/e-ink serif with WebGL fluid background, or Swiss International grid), with presenter view, synced audience screen, speaker-script notes, chapter covers, big-number data pages and image grids.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'magazine-style PPT', 'Swiss style', 'horizontal swipe deck' or share/keynote-style web slides. No build; open the HTML in a browser.
skills.evidence: 27.2k stars since Apr 2026; skills.sh ~26.7k installs; in cosen1024 and brycewang lists. Also ranked in docs_office.
skills.notes: AGPL-3.0 copyleft; SKILL.md at repo root and written in Chinese. Its sponsor note tells the agent not to put sponsor names in generated decks.

skills.name: baoyu-slide-deck
skills.purpose: Turns an article or outline into a styled slide deck where every slide is a generated image: outline, style selection, per-slide prompts, batch image generation, then assembly into PPTX/PDF.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'make slides from this article'. Image generation goes through baoyu-image-gen (your own provider key) or the Codex CLI subscription; install from jimliu/baoyu-skills.
skills.evidence: jimliu/baoyu-skills 26.3k stars; skills.sh ~30.7k installs; in brycewang/many-ppt-skills. Also ranked in docs_office.
skills.notes: Slides are images, so text is not editable; best for social/visual decks, not working decks.

skills.name: presenting-conference-talks
skills.purpose: Turns a compiled research paper into a conference talk: Beamer PDF plus editable PPTX, slide-count rules per talk type (poster-talk, spotlight, oral, invited), slide structure templates, speaker notes and an optional word-for-word talk script.
skills.how_to_use: Use when preparing oral, spotlight or invited ML/systems talks from a paper. Needs python-pptx and a LaTeX install for Beamer.
skills.evidence: Orchestra-Research AI-Research-SKILLs (13.2k stars; repo in VoltAgent and hesreallyhim lists); skills.sh ~0.8k installs.
skills.notes: Academic/ML focus; complements scientific-slides with the paper-to-talk path.

skills.name: html-ppt
skills.purpose: Template-driven static HTML presentation studio: many themes, layouts and animations, 15 full-deck templates (pitch deck, product launch, tech sharing, weekly report, course module), keyboard runtime and a presenter mode with current/next slide, per-slide script and timer.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on presentation/PPT/slides/deck/keynote requests that should be an HTML deck. Mentions of speaker notes or a talk switch it to the presenter-mode template with 150-300 words of script per slide.
skills.evidence: 8.6k stars since Apr 2026; skills.sh ~20.3k installs; in cosen1024 and brycewang lists. Also ranked in docs_office.
skills.notes: SKILL.md at repo root; bilingual (EN/中文).

skills.name: marp-slide
skills.purpose: Creates Marp Markdown decks with 7 ready themes (default, minimal, colorful, dark, gradient, tech, business), image layouts and built-in quality rules for 'make it look good' requests.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on Marp or quick Markdown slide requests; render with Marp CLI or the VS Code Marp extension to HTML/PDF/PPTX.
skills.evidence: skills.sh ~4.1k installs; also distributed on aitmpl (davila7/claude-code-templates creative-design/marp-slide); claudeskills.info PPT list.
skills.notes: Formatting/theme focus; pair with a story skill (presentation-creator or tech-talk-outline).

skills.name: public-speaking
skills.purpose: Delivery coaching built from Lenny's Podcast guests: diagnose whether the problem is preparation, anxiety, slides or delivery; story frameworks (five-second moment, Arrow method); visualization and rehearsal games; humour and executive presence.
skills.how_to_use: Use when the user wants to get better at giving a talk or presentation, handle nerves, or tighten a story. Text-only, no prerequisites.
skills.evidence: Lenny's Podcast skill pack (1.4k stars); ~2.3k installs on skills.sh/claudemarketplaces under its former name giving-presentations; listed on smithery.
skills.notes: Quote-heavy (guest insights in references/); the actionable parts are the frameworks.

skills.name: presenter-notes
skills.purpose: Writes speaker notes that work mid-talk: cue-grain phrases per slide instead of scripts, verbatim lines only for transitions, key numbers and the open/close, timing marks (T/4, T/2, 3T/4) and a built-in Q&A crib.
skills.how_to_use: Use for 'write my speaker notes', running over time, or Q&A prep. Text-only. Siblings in the same repo: deck-narrative-arc (situation-complication-resolution spine and transitions), deck-outline-first, slide-density-rules, data-slide-design, deck-review-rubric, public-speaking-prep, demo-script.
skills.evidence: pm-claude-skills (1.4k stars, MIT); part of a coherent 'cowork' deck cluster (narrative arc, outline-first, density, data slides, review rubric). No meaningful skills.sh install data.
skills.notes: Single 5 KB file; the deck cluster is worth reading together.

skills.name: tech-talk-outline
skills.purpose: Turns an accepted conference abstract into a rehearsable outline: one-sentence takeaway, narrative arc, minute-by-minute time budget, demo placement, slide skeleton and cut checkpoints for when the talk runs long; argues against word-for-word scripts.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'my talk got accepted, now what', 'talk outline', 'what do I cut', 'where should the demo go'. Text-only. Siblings: conference-cfp-submission (the abstract) and developer-live-demo-design (live demos).
skills.evidence: By Samuel Berthe (samber, 2.3k GitHub followers, author of samber/lo); 22 KB skill + 4 references + evals; skills.sh ~2.2k installs within a month.
skills.notes: Repo is new (Sep 2026, 2 stars); every skill in it shows ~2.2k installs, so treat installs as a weak signal. Ranked on content quality.

skills.name: consulting-pptx-skill
skills.purpose: Executive/consulting-grade decks driven by an ~80-rule slide canon distilled from real reviews (action titles, density, chart and wording rules, an 'AI smell' lexicon), a 62-type HTML parts catalogue with a matching editable PPTX sample, and a check_deck.py / Playwright layout check that must reach FAIL 0.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'consulting-quality slides' or decks that follow house rules. Output is 16:9 HTML printed to PDF via Chrome; `npm run setup` installs Playwright for the layout check; Python for new_deck.py and check_deck.py.
skills.evidence: Fast-rising: 918 stars since creation on 2 Sep 2026 (among the top PPTX skill repos created after Jun 2026, with dashi-ppt, genoffice and CyberPPT); skills.sh ~43 installs so far.
skills.notes: SKILL.md and rules are in Japanese. README links to the authors' Jinba SaaS (marketing only; the skill makes no network calls).

skills.name: revealjs
skills.purpose: Builds polished reveal.js decks (HTML + CSS from CDN, no build): content-led theme and palette choice, multi-column layouts, code highlighting, fragments and animations, speaker notes and custom styling.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on slides/presentation/deck requests where reveal.js is wanted; open the HTML in a browser, press S for the speaker view.
skills.evidence: Most-starred dedicated reveal.js skill (413); claudemarketplaces ~0.6k installs; in cosen1024 and brycewang lists.
skills.notes: Alternative: pamelafox/presentation-skills make-revealjs-presentation (house template, 125 stars).

skills.name: presentation-creator
skills.purpose: End-to-end deck writing: story spine, slide sequence and copy, a house visual system, density by setting (live talk vs read-alone), speaker notes, and investor pitch deck structure; outputs Marp (default), Slidev or reveal.js markdown, or a Next.js deck app.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'create a presentation', 'write a pitch deck', 'turn this doc into slides'. Hands finished outline/copy/notes to a PPTX skill when an editable .pptx is needed.
skills.evidence: 11 KB skill with 8 references (story structure, pitch decks, speaker notes, visual design, web deck) and evals; skills.sh ~0.7k installs; repo in VoltAgent list.
skills.notes: Best English source here for startup/investor pitch-deck story; low stars.

skills.name: automating-keynote

skills.how_to_use: macOS only; grant Automation permission to Keynote (setup script runs a read-only osascript call). Optional PyXA via the sibling automating-mac-apps skill.
skills.evidence: Only substantive Keynote skill found (66 KB incl. references and scripts, integration test); skills.sh ~0.1k installs.
skills.notes: Low stars; included for Keynote coverage. Keynote also opens PPTX, so the PPTX skills are the usual route.
